Name: Daily Shipping List
Author: moriAHIRU
Description:
[size=5][b]Daily Shipping List[/b][/size]

Have you ever accidentally placed a valuable item or tool into your shipping bin and realized it too late?
[b]Daily Shipping List[/b] is a Quality of Life (QoL) mod that lets you inspect everything you've shipped today and retrieve items back into your inventory before the day ends!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53131/53131-1790772950-488207623.jpg[/img]

[line]

[size=4][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Shipping Bin Overview:[/b] Displays all items placed in your daily shipping bins with item icons, stack counts, and individual/total gold earnings.[/*]
[*][b]Item Retrieval Function:[/b] Click the return button next to any item to return it safely back to your player inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Mini-Shipping Bin Support:[/b] Fully tracks items shipped through both the main farm shipping bin and any Mini-Shipping Bins.[/*]
[*][b]Scrollable Menu:[/b] Handles large numbers of shipped items smoothly with a built-in scrollbar.[/*]
[*][b]Multilingual Support (i18n):[/b] Supports both English and Japanese with dynamically adjusted UI layouts and text scales.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]🎮 How to Use[/b][/size]

1. Press [b]K[/b] (default key) anywhere to open the Daily Shipping List menu.
2. Check your shipped items and current total gold earnings.
3. Click the [b]Return Button[/b] next to an item to return it to your inventory.

[b]⚙️ Customizing the Keybind[/b]
When you launch the game with this mod for the first time, a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file will be automatically generated inside the mod folder.
Open [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] with any text editor and change [font=Courier New]"ToggleMenuKey": "K"[/font] to your preferred key (e.g., [font=Courier New]"J"[/font], [font=Courier New]"F5"[/font]).

[line]

[size=4][b]⚙ Requirements & Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] v1.6 or later[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] v4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download this mod and extract the zip file.
3. Place the [font=Courier New]DailyShippingList[/font] folder into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] directory.
4. Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[line]

[b]🇯🇵 日本語での概要 (Overview in Japanese)[/b]
[spoiler]
当日の出荷箱（メイン・ミニ出荷箱）に入れたアイテムの一覧、個数、合計価格を確認し、間違えて入れたアイテムをいつでも手元（インベントリ）に戻せるMODです。

【使い方】
・デフォルトでは [b]Kキー[/b] でメニューが開きます。
・回収したいアイテムの横にある「戻す」ボタンをクリックするとインベントリに戻ります。
・キー変更は MOD フォルダ内に自動生成される [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] から変更可能です。
